title: Sofia municipal-transport workers demand agreement implementation, wage rise and state funding

occurrence.summary: BNR article body reports an actual gathering outside Sofia Municipality.

size.summary: BNR reports more than 300 workers and union members; no exact count.

demand.summary: Participants demanded implementation of the bonus-system agreement, at least 15% base-pay increase from 2025 and immediate state funds due to the municipality.

state_target.summary: Demand included state funds due to the municipality; additional bargaining demand was directed to municipal employer.

end.summary: End time/date not reported; possible 11 October strike was announced only, not confirmed.

open_questions: Did the announced possible one-hour strike on 11 October actually occur, and what were the event end/response details?

location.summary: Outside the Interior Ministry in Sofia.

size.summary: No attendance number or 50-person threshold evidence in the body.

demand.summary: Organizers demanded Interior Minister resignation, alleging inaction on vote buying and pressure/cover-up.

state_target.summary: Demand is directed at the Interior Minister and ministry.

title: Sofia election-annulment protests reported for three consecutive days

occurrence.summary: BNT confirms protest on 31 October; BTA says it was the third consecutive day.

size.summary: No simultaneous participant count found in accessible reports.

demand.summary: Participants demanded annulment/cancellation of the 27 October parliamentary election.

state_target.summary: Demand concerns the state election process and its annulment.

date.summary: 31 October was the third consecutive day per BTA; 29 October onset is inferred from that wording, not directly timestamped.

end.summary: 31 October is documented; end beyond this day is not established.

open_questions: Can a dated source establish the series onset, daily occurrence/attendance, and continuity after 31 October?
